title: Mary L
content: My mother was dying. I had been her sole caretaker for two years while she suffered from dementia. She had been on hospice for three weeks, and soon I realized she was actively dying. The hospice nurse and physician came and told me what to expect and what to do when it happened. The priest from a local Catholic church came to give her last rites. At 4:30 AM, I watched as my mother took her last breath. At that very moment, the TV in her room turned bright blue and displayed, "complete signal loss." Then I felt what seemed like bubbles or large marbles pass from her hand into mine. I let go of her hand and went into the living room to wake up my daughter, who had just fallen asleep. To my surprise, she had felt something very hot near her at the same time I felt the bubbles. We knew it was her energy and it made the TV turn off too.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, My mother was dying, Other (briefly specify), My mother was dying
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, It was supernatural
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was 100% alert and watching my mom die
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes, I have a huge interest in anything related.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I never expected to feel anything pass from her hand into mine.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I was not sure about an afterlife, but now I am 100% certain.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I can relive this experience as it happened for years after.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Yes, holding my mom's hand and the feeling I had. I started collecting hands.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I knew it was real the moment I felt it.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, Because she had not moved a muscle in 48 hours, I felt nothing in her hand until she died.
